content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
content.english: O strength and stay upholding all creation,

content.latin: Immótus in te pérmanens,
content.english: Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,

content.latin: Lucis diúrnæ témpora
content.english: Yet day by day the light in due gradation

content.latin: Succéssibus detérminans:
content.english: From hour to hour through all its changes guide:

content.latin: Largíre lumen véspere,
content.english: Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,

content.latin: Quo vita nusquam décidat,
content.english: An eve untouched by shadows of decay,

content.latin: Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
content.english: The brightness of a holy death-bed blending

content.latin: Perénnis instet glória.
content.english: With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Now and to endless ages art adored.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Trahe nos, * Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.
content.english: Ant. Draw us, * Maiden undefiled, we will run after thee in the odour of thy perfumes.

segments.t: Ant.
Trahe nos, * Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.

content.latin: 118:129 (Phe) Mirabília testimónia tua: * ídeo scrutáta est ea ánima mea.
content.english: 118:129 (Phe) Thy testimonies are wonderful: * therefore my soul hath sought them.

segments.t: Mirabília testimónia tua: * ídeo scrutáta est ea ánima mea.

content.latin: 118:130 Declarátio sermónum tuórum illúminat: * et intelléctum dat párvulis.
content.english: 118:130 The declaration of thy words giveth light: * and giveth understanding to little ones.

segments.t: Declarátio sermónum tuórum illúminat: * et intelléctum dat párvulis.

content.latin: 118:131 Os meum apérui, et attráxi spíritum: * quia mandáta tua desiderábam.
content.english: 118:131 I opened my mouth, and panted: * because I longed for thy commandments.

segments.t: Os meum apérui, et attráxi spíritum: * quia mandáta tua desiderábam.

content.latin: 118:132 Áspice in me, et miserére mei, * secúndum iudícium diligéntium nomen tuum.
content.english: 118:132 Look thou upon me, and have mercy on me, * according to the judgment of them that love thy name.

segments.t: Áspice in me, et miserére mei, * secúndum iudícium diligéntium nomen tuum.

content.latin: 118:133 Gressus meos dírige secúndum elóquium tuum: * et non dominétur mei omnis iniustítia.
content.english: 118:133 Direct my steps according to thy word: * and let no iniquity have dominion over me.

segments.t: Gressus meos dírige secúndum elóquium tuum: * et non dominétur mei omnis iniustítia.

content.latin: 118:134 Rédime me a calúmniis hóminum: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:134 Redeem me from the calumnies of men: * that I may keep thy commandments.

segments.t: Rédime me a calúmniis hóminum: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:135 Fáciem tuam illúmina super servum tuum: * et doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
content.english: 118:135 Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: * and teach me thy justifications.

segments.t: Fáciem tuam illúmina super servum tuum: * et doce me iustificatiónes tuas.

content.latin: 118:136 Éxitus aquárum deduxérunt óculi mei: * quia non custodiérunt legem tuam.
content.english: 118:136 My eyes have sent forth springs of water: * because they have not kept thy law.

segments.t: Éxitus aquárum deduxérunt óculi mei: * quia non custodiérunt legem tuam.

content.latin: 118:137 (Sade) Iustus es, Dómine: * et rectum iudícium tuum.
content.english: 118:137 (Sade) Thou art just, O Lord: * and thy judgment is right.

segments.t: Iustus es, Dómine: * et rectum iudícium tuum.

content.latin: 118:138 Mandásti iustítiam testimónia tua: * et veritátem tuam nimis.
content.english: 118:138 Thou hast commanded justice thy testimonies: * and thy truth exceedingly.

segments.t: Mandásti iustítiam testimónia tua: * et veritátem tuam nimis.

content.latin: 118:139 Tabéscere me fecit zelus meus: * quia oblíti sunt verba tua inimíci mei.
content.english: 118:139 My zeal hath made me pine away: * because my enemies forgot thy words.

segments.t: Tabéscere me fecit zelus meus: * quia oblíti sunt verba tua inimíci mei.

content.latin: 118:140 Ignítum elóquium tuum veheménter: * et servus tuus diléxit illud.
content.english: 118:140 Thy word is exceedingly refined: * and thy servant hath loved it.

segments.t: Ignítum elóquium tuum veheménter: * et servus tuus diléxit illud.

content.latin: 118:141 Adolescéntulus sum ego et contémptus: * iustificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
content.english: 118:141 I am very young and despised; but * I forget not thy justifications.

segments.t: Adolescéntulus sum ego et contémptus: * iustificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.

content.latin: 118:142 Iustítia tua, iustítia in ætérnum: * et lex tua véritas.
content.english: 118:142 Thy justice is justice for ever: * and thy law is the truth.

segments.t: Iustítia tua, iustítia in ætérnum: * et lex tua véritas.

content.latin: 118:143 Tribulátio, et angústia invenérunt me: * mandáta tua meditátio mea est.
content.english: 118:143 Trouble and anguish have found me: * thy commandments are my meditation.

segments.t: Tribulátio, et angústia invenérunt me: * mandáta tua meditátio mea est.

content.latin: 118:144 Ǽquitas testimónia tua in ætérnum: * intelléctum da mihi, et vivam.
content.english: 118:144 Thy testimonies are justice for ever: * give me understanding, and I shall live.

segments.t: Ǽquitas testimónia tua in ætérnum: * intelléctum da mihi, et vivam.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: 118:145 (Coph) Clamávi in toto corde meo, exáudi me, Dómine: * iustificatiónes tuas requíram.
content.english: 118:145 (Coph) I cried with my whole heart, hear me, O Lord: * I will seek thy justifications.

segments.t: Clamávi in toto corde meo, exáudi me, Dómine: * iustificatiónes tuas requíram.

content.latin: 118:146 Clamávi ad te, salvum me fac: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:146 I cried unto thee, save me: * that I may keep thy commandments.

segments.t: Clamávi ad te, salvum me fac: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:147 Prævéni in maturitáte, et clamávi: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.
content.english: 118:147 I prevented the dawning of the day, and cried: * because in thy words I very much hoped.

segments.t: Prævéni in maturitáte, et clamávi: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.

content.latin: 118:148 Prævenérunt óculi mei ad te dilúculo: * ut meditárer elóquia tua.
content.english: 118:148 My eyes to thee have prevented the morning: * that I might meditate on thy words.

segments.t: Prævenérunt óculi mei ad te dilúculo: * ut meditárer elóquia tua.

content.latin: 118:149 Vocem meam audi secúndum misericórdiam tuam, Dómine: * et secúndum iudícium tuum vivífica me.
content.english: 118:149 Hear thou my voice, O Lord, according to thy mercy: * and quicken me according to thy judgment.

segments.t: Vocem meam audi secúndum misericórdiam tuam, Dómine: * et secúndum iudícium tuum vivífica me.

content.latin: 118:150 Appropinquavérunt persequéntes me iniquitáti: * a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.
content.english: 118:150 They that persecute me have drawn nigh to iniquity; * but they are gone far off from thy law.

segments.t: Appropinquavérunt persequéntes me iniquitáti: * a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.

content.latin: 118:151 Prope es tu, Dómine: * et omnes viæ tuæ véritas.
content.english: 118:151 Thou art near, O Lord: * and all thy ways are truth.

segments.t: Prope es tu, Dómine: * et omnes viæ tuæ véritas.

content.latin: 118:152 Inítio cognóvi de testimóniis tuis: * quia in ætérnum fundásti ea.
content.english: 118:152 I have known from the beginning concerning thy testimonies: * that thou hast founded them for ever.

segments.t: Inítio cognóvi de testimóniis tuis: * quia in ætérnum fundásti ea.

content.latin: 118:153 (Res) Vide humilitátem meam, et éripe me: * quia legem tuam non sum oblítus.
content.english: 118:153 (Res) See my humiliation and deliver me: * for I have not forgotten thy law.

segments.t: Vide humilitátem meam, et éripe me: * quia legem tuam non sum oblítus.

content.latin: 118:154 Iúdica iudícium meum, et rédime me: * propter elóquium tuum vivífica me.
content.english: 118:154 Judge my judgment and redeem me: * quicken thou me for thy word’s sake.

segments.t: Iúdica iudícium meum, et rédime me: * propter elóquium tuum vivífica me.

content.latin: 118:155 Longe a peccatóribus salus: * quia iustificatiónes tuas non exquisiérunt.
content.english: 118:155 Salvation is far from sinners; * because they have not sought thy justifications.

segments.t: Longe a peccatóribus salus: * quia iustificatiónes tuas non exquisiérunt.

content.latin: 118:156 Misericórdiæ tuæ multæ, Dómine: * secúndum iudícium tuum vivífica me.
content.english: 118:156 Many, O Lord, are thy mercies: * quicken me according to thy judgment.

segments.t: Misericórdiæ tuæ multæ, Dómine: * secúndum iudícium tuum vivífica me.

content.latin: 118:157 Multi qui persequúntur me, et tríbulant me: * a testimóniis tuis non declinávi.
content.english: 118:157 Many are they that persecute me, and afflict me; * but I have not declined from thy testimonies.

segments.t: Multi qui persequúntur me, et tríbulant me: * a testimóniis tuis non declinávi.

content.latin: 118:158 Vidi prævaricántes, et tabescébam: * quia elóquia tua non custodiérunt.
content.english: 118:158 I beheld the transgressors, and I pined away; * because they kept not thy word.

segments.t: Vidi prævaricántes, et tabescébam: * quia elóquia tua non custodiérunt.

content.latin: 118:159 Vide quóniam mandáta tua diléxi, Dómine: * in misericórdia tua vivífica me.
content.english: 118:159 Behold I have loved thy commandments, O Lord; * quicken me thou in thy mercy.

segments.t: Vide quóniam mandáta tua diléxi, Dómine: * in misericórdia tua vivífica me.

content.latin: 118:160 Princípium verbórum tuórum, véritas: * in ætérnum ómnia iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
content.english: 118:160 The beginning of thy words is truth: * all the judgments of thy justice are for ever.

segments.t: Princípium verbórum tuórum, véritas: * in ætérnum ómnia iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: 118:161 (Sin) Príncipes persecúti sunt me gratis: * et a verbis tuis formidávit cor meum.
content.english: 118:161 (Sin) Princes have persecuted me without cause: * and my heart hath been in awe of thy words.

segments.t: Príncipes persecúti sunt me gratis: * et a verbis tuis formidávit cor meum.

content.latin: 118:162 Lætábor ego super elóquia tua: * sicut qui invénit spólia multa.
content.english: 118:162 I will rejoice at thy words, * as one that hath found great spoil.

segments.t: Lætábor ego super elóquia tua: * sicut qui invénit spólia multa.

content.latin: 118:163 Iniquitátem ódio hábui, et abominátus sum: * legem autem tuam diléxi.
content.english: 118:163 I have hated and abhorred iniquity; * but I have loved thy law.

segments.t: Iniquitátem ódio hábui, et abominátus sum: * legem autem tuam diléxi.

content.latin: 118:164 Sépties in die laudem dixi tibi, * super iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
content.english: 118:164 Seven times a day I have given praise to thee, * for the judgments of thy justice.

segments.t: Sépties in die laudem dixi tibi, * super iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.

content.latin: 118:165 Pax multa diligéntibus legem tuam: * et non est illis scándalum.
content.english: 118:165 Much peace have they that love thy law, * and to them there is no stumbling-block.

segments.t: Pax multa diligéntibus legem tuam: * et non est illis scándalum.

content.latin: 118:166 Exspectábam salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et mandáta tua diléxi.
content.english: 118:166 I looked for thy salvation, O Lord: * and I loved thy commandments.

segments.t: Exspectábam salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et mandáta tua diléxi.

content.latin: 118:167 Custodívit ánima mea testimónia tua: * et diléxit ea veheménter.
content.english: 118:167 My soul hath kept thy testimonies: * and hath loved them exceedingly.

segments.t: Custodívit ánima mea testimónia tua: * et diléxit ea veheménter.

content.latin: 118:168 Servávi mandáta tua, et testimónia tua: * quia omnes viæ meæ in conspéctu tuo.
content.english: 118:168 I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies: * because all my ways are in thy sight.

segments.t: Servávi mandáta tua, et testimónia tua: * quia omnes viæ meæ in conspéctu tuo.

content.latin: 118:169 (Thau) Appropínquet deprecátio mea in conspéctu tuo, Dómine: * iuxta elóquium tuum da mihi intelléctum.
content.english: 118:169 (Tau) Let my supplication, O Lord, come near in thy sight: * give me understanding according to thy word.

segments.t: Appropínquet deprecátio mea in conspéctu tuo, Dómine: * iuxta elóquium tuum da mihi intelléctum.

content.latin: 118:170 Intret postulátio mea in conspéctu tuo: * secúndum elóquium tuum éripe me.
content.english: 118:170 Let my request come in before thee; * deliver thou me according to thy word.

segments.t: Intret postulátio mea in conspéctu tuo: * secúndum elóquium tuum éripe me.

content.latin: 118:171 Eructábunt lábia mea hymnum, * cum docúeris me iustificatiónes tuas.
content.english: 118:171 My lips shall utter a hymn, * when thou shalt teach me thy justifications.

segments.t: Eructábunt lábia mea hymnum, * cum docúeris me iustificatiónes tuas.

content.latin: 118:172 Pronuntiábit lingua mea elóquium tuum: * quia ómnia mandáta tua ǽquitas.
content.english: 118:172 My tongue shall pronounce thy word: * because all thy commandments are justice.

segments.t: Pronuntiábit lingua mea elóquium tuum: * quia ómnia mandáta tua ǽquitas.

content.latin: 118:173 Fiat manus tua ut salvet me: * quóniam mandáta tua elégi.
content.english: 118:173 Let thy hand be with me to save me; * for I have chosen thy precepts.

segments.t: Fiat manus tua ut salvet me: * quóniam mandáta tua elégi.

content.latin: 118:174 Concupívi salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et lex tua meditátio mea est.
content.english: 118:174 I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; * and thy law is my meditation.

segments.t: Concupívi salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et lex tua meditátio mea est.

content.latin: 118:175 Vivet ánima mea, et laudábit te: * et iudícia tua adiuvábunt me.
content.english: 118:175 My soul shall live and shall praise thee: * and thy judgments shall help me.

segments.t: Vivet ánima mea, et laudábit te: * et iudícia tua adiuvábunt me.

content.latin: 118:176 Errávi, sicut ovis, quæ périit: * quære servum tuum, quia mandáta tua non sum oblítus.
content.english: 118:176 I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost: * seek thy servant, because I have not forgotten thy commandments.

segments.t: Errávi, sicut ovis, quæ périit: * quære servum tuum, quia mandáta tua non sum oblítus.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Trahe nos, Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.
content.english: Ant. Draw us, Maiden undefiled, we will run after thee in the odour of thy perfumes.

segments.t: Ant.
Trahe nos, Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.

content.latin: Apo 12:1
content.english: Rev 12:1

segments.t: Apo 12:1

content.latin: Signum magnum appáruit in cælo: Múlier amícta sole, et luna sub pédibus eius, et in cápite eius coróna stellárum duódecim.
content.english: And a great sign appeared in heaven: A woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟.br. Exaltábo te, Dómine, * Quóniam suscepísti me.
content.english: ℟.br. I will extol thee, O Lord, * for Thou hast lifted me up.

segments.t: ℟.br.
Exaltábo te, Dómine, * Quóniam suscepísti me.

content.latin: ℟. Exaltábo te, Dómine, * Quóniam suscepísti me.
content.english: ℟. I will extol thee, O Lord, * for Thou hast lifted me up.

segments.t: Exaltábo te, Dómine, * Quóniam suscepísti me.

content.latin: ℣. Nec delectásti inimícos meos super me.
content.english: ℣. And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

segments.t: Nec delectásti inimícos meos super me.

content.latin: ℟. Quóniam suscepísti me.
content.english: ℟. Thou hast lifted me up.

segments.t: Quóniam suscepísti me.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Exaltábo te, Dómine, * Quóniam suscepísti me.
content.english: ℟. I will extol thee, O Lord, * for Thou hast lifted me up.

segments.t: Exaltábo te, Dómine, * Quóniam suscepísti me.

content.latin: ℣. Immaculáta Concéptio tua, Dei Génetrix Virgo.
content.english: ℣. Maiden Mother of God, thy stainless conception.

segments.t: Immaculáta Concéptio tua, Dei Génetrix Virgo.

content.latin: ℟. Gáudium annuntiávit univérso mundo.
content.english: ℟. Was a message of joy to the whole world.

segments.t: Gáudium annuntiávit univérso mundo.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui per immaculátam Vírginis Conceptiónem dignum Fílio tuo habitáculum præparásti: quǽsumus; ut qui ex morte eiúsdem Fílii tui prævísa, eam ab omni labe præservásti, nos quoque mundos eius intercessióne ad te perveníre concédas.
content.english: O God, by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin, thou prepared a worthy habitation for thy Son; we beseech thee, that, as by the foreseen death of thy same Son thou preserved her from all stain of sin, so thou would grant us also, through her intercession, to come to thee with pure hearts.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Tota pulchra * es, María, et mácula originális non est in te.
content.english: Ant. Thou art all fair, O Mary, * there is no spot of original sin in thee.

segments.t: Ant.
Tota pulchra * es, María, et mácula originális non est in te.

content.latin: Psalmus 109 [1]
content.english: Psalm 109 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 109

content.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
content.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

segments.t: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:

content.latin: 109:1 Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
content.english: 109:1 Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

segments.t: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:2 Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
content.english: 109:2 The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

segments.t: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:3 Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
content.english: 109:3 With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

segments.t: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.

content.latin: 109:4 Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
content.english: 109:4 The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.

content.latin: 109:5 Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
content.english: 109:5 The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

segments.t: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.

content.latin: 109:6 Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
content.english: 109:6 He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

segments.t: Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.

content.latin: 109:7 De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
content.english: 109:7 He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

segments.t: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Tota pulchra es, María, et mácula originális non est in te.
content.english: Ant. Thou art all fair, O Mary, there is no spot of original sin in thee.

segments.t: Ant.
Tota pulchra es, María, et mácula originális non est in te.

content.latin: Ant. Vestiméntum tuum * cándidum quasi nix, et fácies tua sicut sol.
content.english: Ant. Thy raiment * is white as snow, and thy countenance as the sun.

segments.t: Ant.
Vestiméntum tuum * cándidum quasi nix, et fácies tua sicut sol.

content.latin: Psalmus 112 [2]
content.english: Psalm 112 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 112

content.latin: 112:1 Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.
content.english: 112:1 Praise the Lord, ye children: * praise ye the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 112:2 (fit reverentia) Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
content.english: 112:2 (bow head) Blessed be the name of the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

segments.t: 112:2 (fit reverentia)
Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.

content.latin: 112:3 A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
content.english: 112:3 From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

segments.t: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 112:4 Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
content.english: 112:4 The Lord is high above all nations; * and his glory above the heavens.

segments.t: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.

content.latin: 112:5 Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
content.english: 112:5 Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high: * and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

segments.t: Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?

content.latin: 112:7 Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
content.english: 112:7 Raising up the needy from the earth, * and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

segments.t: Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:

content.latin: 112:8 Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
content.english: 112:8 That he may place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.

segments.t: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.

content.latin: 112:9 Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
content.english: 112:9 Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.

segments.t: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Vestiméntum tuum cándidum quasi nix, et fácies tua sicut sol.
content.english: Ant. Thy raiment is white as snow, and thy countenance as the sun.

segments.t: Ant.
Vestiméntum tuum cándidum quasi nix, et fácies tua sicut sol.

content.latin: Ant. Tu glória Ierúsalem, * tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.
content.english: Ant. Thou art the exaltation of Jerusalem, * thou art the great glory of Israel, thou art the great rejoicing of our nation.

segments.t: Ant.
Tu glória Ierúsalem, * tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.

content.latin: Psalmus 121 [3]
content.english: Psalm 121 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 121

content.latin: 121:1 Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.
content.english: 121:1 I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: * We shall go into the house of the Lord.

segments.t: Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.

content.latin: 121:2 Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Ierúsalem.
content.english: 121:2 Our feet were standing * in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

segments.t: Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Ierúsalem.

content.latin: 121:3 Ierúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cuius participátio eius in idípsum.
content.english: 121:3 Jerusalem, which is built as a city, * which is compact together.

segments.t: Ierúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cuius participátio eius in idípsum.

content.latin: 121:4 Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.
content.english: 121:4 For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord: * the testimony of Israel, to praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.

content.latin: 121:5 Quia illic sedérunt sedes in iudício, * sedes super domum David.
content.english: 121:5 Because their seats have sat in judgment, * seats upon the house of David.

segments.t: Quia illic sedérunt sedes in iudício, * sedes super domum David.

content.latin: 121:6 Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Ierúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:
content.english: 121:6 Pray ye for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem: * and abundance for them that love thee.

segments.t: Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Ierúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:

content.latin: 121:7 Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
content.english: 121:7 Let peace be in thy strength: * and abundance in thy towers.

segments.t: Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.

content.latin: 121:8 Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:
content.english: 121:8 For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, * I spoke peace of thee.

segments.t: Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:

content.latin: 121:9 Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.
content.english: 121:9 Because of the house of the Lord our God, * I have sought good things for thee.

segments.t: Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Tu glória Ierúsalem, tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.
content.english: Ant. Thou art the exaltation of Jerusalem, thou art the great glory of Israel, thou art the great rejoicing of our nation.

segments.t: Ant.
Tu glória Ierúsalem, tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícta es tu, * Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
content.english: Ant. Virgin Mary, * blessed art thou of the Most High God, above all the women upon the earth.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícta es tu, * Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.

content.latin: Psalmus 126 [4]
content.english: Psalm 126 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 126

content.latin: 126:1 Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, * in vanum laboravérunt qui ædíficant eam.
content.english: 126:1 Unless the Lord build the house, * they labour in vain that build it.

segments.t: Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, * in vanum laboravérunt qui ædíficant eam.

content.latin: 126:1 Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.
content.english: 126:1 Unless the Lord keep the city, * he watcheth in vain that keepeth it.

segments.t: Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.

content.latin: 126:2 Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere: * súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.
content.english: 126:2 It is vain for you to rise before light, * rise ye after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow.

segments.t: Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere: * súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.

content.latin: 126:2 Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.
content.english: 126:2 When he shall give sleep to his beloved, * behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.

segments.t: Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.

content.latin: 126:4 Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.
content.english: 126:4 As arrows in the hand of the mighty, * so the children of them that have been shaken.

segments.t: Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.

content.latin: 126:5 Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.
content.english: 126:5 Blessed is the man that hath filled the desire with them; * he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

segments.t: Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícta es tu, Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
content.english: Ant. Virgin Mary, blessed art thou of the Most High God, above all the women upon the earth.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícta es tu, Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.

content.latin: Ant. Trahe nos, * Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.
content.english: Ant. Draw us, * Maiden undefiled, we will run after thee in the odour of thy perfumes.

segments.t: Ant.
Trahe nos, * Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.

content.latin: Psalmus 147 [5]
content.english: Psalm 147 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 147

content.latin: 147:1 Lauda, Ierúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
content.english: 147:1 Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem: * praise thy God, O Sion.

segments.t: Lauda, Ierúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.

content.latin: 147:2 Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
content.english: 147:2 Because he hath strengthened the bolts of thy gates * he hath blessed thy children within thee.

segments.t: Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.

content.latin: 147:3 Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
content.english: 147:3 Who hath placed peace in thy borders: * and filleth thee with the fat of corn.

segments.t: Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.

content.latin: 147:4 Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.
content.english: 147:4 Who sendeth forth his speech to the earth: * his word runneth swiftly.

segments.t: Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.

content.latin: 147:5 Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
content.english: 147:5 Who giveth snow like wool: * scattereth mists like ashes.

segments.t: Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.

content.latin: 147:6 Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?
content.english: 147:6 He sendeth his crystal like morsels: * who shall stand before the face of his cold?

segments.t: Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?

content.latin: 147:7 Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.
content.english: 147:7 He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.

segments.t: Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.

content.latin: 147:8 Qui annúntiat verbum suum Iacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.
content.english: 147:8 Who declareth his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.

segments.t: Qui annúntiat verbum suum Iacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.

content.latin: 147:9 Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.
content.english: 147:9 He hath not done in like manner to every nation: * and his judgments he hath not made manifest to them.

segments.t: Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Trahe nos, Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.
content.english: Ant. Draw us, Maiden undefiled, we will run after thee in the odour of thy perfumes.

segments.t: Ant.
Trahe nos, Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.

content.latin: Dóminus possédit me in inítio viárum suárum, ántequam quidquam fáceret a princípio. Ab ætérno ordináta sum, et ex antíquis ántequam terra fíeret. Nondum erant abýssi, et ego iam concépta eram.
content.english: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his ways, before he made any thing from the beginning. I was set up from eternity, and of old before the earth was made. The depths were not as yet, and I was already conceived.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Prima stropha sequentis hymni dicitur flexis genibus.
content.english: The first verse of the following hymn is said genuflecting.

segments.t: Prima stropha sequentis hymni dicitur flexis genibus.

content.latin: Ave maris stella,
content.english: Ave, star of ocean,

content.latin: Dei Mater alma,
content.english: Child divine who barest,

content.latin: Atque semper Virgo,
content.english: Mother, ever-Virgin,

content.latin: Felix cæli porta.
content.english: Heaven's portal fairest.

content.latin: Sumens illud Ave
content.english: Taking that sweet Ave

content.latin: Gabriélis ore,
content.english: Erst by Gabriel spoken,

content.latin: Funda nos in pace,
content.english: Eva's name reversing,

content.latin: Mutans Hevæ nomen.
content.english: Be of peace the token.

content.latin: Solve vincla reis,
content.english: Break the sinners' fetters,

content.latin: Profer lumen cæcis,
content.english: Light to blind restoring,

content.latin: Mala nostra pelle,
content.english: All our ills dispelling,

content.latin: Bona cuncta posce.
content.english: Every boon imploring.

content.latin: Monstra te esse matrem,
content.english: Show thyself a mother

content.latin: Sumat per te preces,
content.english: In thy supplication;

content.latin: Qui pro nobis natus,
content.english: He will hear who chose thee

content.latin: Tulit esse tuus.
content.english: At his incarnation.

content.latin: Virgo singuláris,
content.english: Maid all maids excelling,

content.latin: Inter omnes mitis,
content.english: Passing meek and lowly,

content.latin: Nos culpis solútos
content.english: Win for sinners pardon,

content.latin: Mites fac et castos.
content.english: Make us chaste and holy.

content.latin: Vitam præsta puram,
content.english: As we onward journey

content.latin: Iter para tutum,
content.english: Aid our weak endeavour,

content.latin: Ut vidéntes Iesum,
content.english: Till we gaze on Jesus

content.latin: Semper collætémur.
content.english: And rejoice forever.

content.latin: Sit laus Deo Patri,
content.english: Father, Son, and Spirit,

content.latin: Summo Christo decus,
content.english: Three in One confessing,

content.latin: Spirítui Sancto,
content.english: Give we equal glory

content.latin: Tribus honor unus.
content.english: Equal praise and blessing.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Immaculáta Concéptio est hódie sanctæ Maríæ Vírginis.
content.english: ℣. This day is the Holy Virgin Mary conceived without sin.

segments.t: Immaculáta Concéptio est hódie sanctæ Maríæ Vírginis.

content.latin: ℟. Quæ serpéntis caput virgíneo pede contrívit.
content.english: ℟. The Virgin's foot hath bruised the serpent's head.

segments.t: Quæ serpéntis caput virgíneo pede contrívit.

content.latin: Ant. Hódie egréssa est * virga de radíce Iesse: hódie sine ulla peccáti labe concépta est María: hódie contrítum est ab ea caput serpéntis antíqui, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. This day is a rod * sprung from the root of Jesse: this day is Mary conceived without any stain of sin: this day hath she bruised the head of the old serpent, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Hódie egréssa est * virga de radíce Iesse: hódie sine ulla peccáti labe concépta est María: hódie contrítum est ab ea caput serpéntis antíqui, allelúia.

content.latin: Canticum B. Mariæ Virginis
content.english: Canticle of the Blessed Virgin

segments.t: Canticum B. Mariæ Virginis

content.latin: 1:46 Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.
content.english: 1:46 My soul ✠ * doth magnify the Lord.

segments.t: Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.

content.latin: 1:47 Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
content.english: 1:47 And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

segments.t: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.

content.latin: 1:48 Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
content.english: 1:48 Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

segments.t: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.

content.latin: 1:49 Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
content.english: 1:49 Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

segments.t: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.

content.latin: 1:50 Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
content.english: 1:50 And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

segments.t: Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 1:51 Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
content.english: 1:51 He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

segments.t: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.

content.latin: 1:52 Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.
content.english: 1:52 He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

segments.t: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.

content.latin: 1:53 Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
content.english: 1:53 He hath filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he hath sent empty away.

segments.t: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.

content.latin: 1:54 Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
content.english: 1:54 He hath received Israel his servant, * being mindful of his mercy:

segments.t: Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.

content.latin: 1:55 Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.
content.english: 1:55 As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

segments.t: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Hódie egréssa est virga de radíce Iesse: hódie sine ulla peccáti labe concépta est María: hódie contrítum est ab ea caput serpéntis antíqui, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. This day is a rod sprung from the root of Jesse: this day is Mary conceived without any stain of sin: this day hath she bruised the head of the old serpent, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Hódie egréssa est virga de radíce Iesse: hódie sine ulla peccáti labe concépta est María: hódie contrítum est ab ea caput serpéntis antíqui, allelúia.

content.english: Weekday Intercessions{omit}

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui per immaculátam Vírginis Conceptiónem dignum Fílio tuo habitáculum præparásti: quǽsumus; ut qui ex morte eiúsdem Fílii tui prævísa, eam ab omni labe præservásti, nos quoque mundos eius intercessióne ad te perveníre concédas.
content.english: O God, by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin, thou prepared a worthy habitation for thy Son; we beseech thee, that, as by the foreseen death of thy same Son thou preserved her from all stain of sin, so thou would grant us also, through her intercession, to come to thee with pure hearts.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Commemoratio Feria III infra Hebdomadam II Adventus
content.english: Commemoration of Feria III infra Hebdomadam II Adventus

segments.t: Commemoratio Feria III infra Hebdomadam II Adventus

content.latin: Ant. Vox clamántis in desérto, Paráte viam Dómini, rectas fácite sémitas Dei nostri.
content.english: Ant. The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make His paths straight.

segments.t: Ant.
Vox clamántis in desérto, Paráte viam Dómini, rectas fácite sémitas Dei nostri.

content.latin: ℣. Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
content.english: ℣. Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

segments.t: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.

content.latin: ℟. Aperiátur terra, et gérminet Salvatórem.
content.english: ℟. Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

segments.t: Aperiátur terra, et gérminet Salvatórem.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
content.english: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service:

content.latin: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.
content.english: Benediction. May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Fratres: Sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
content.english: Brothers: Be sober and watch: because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Whom resist ye, strong in faith.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.
content.english: ℣. Our help is ✠ in the name of the Lord,

segments.t: Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.

content.latin: ℟. Qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: ℟. Who made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.
content.english: There follows an examination of conscience, or the Our Father said silently.

segments.t: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:
percutit sibi pectus

mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.

content.latin: Misereátur nostri omnípotens Deus, et dimíssis peccátis nostris, perdúcat nos ad vitam ætérnam. Amen.
content.english: May almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.

content.latin: Indulgéntiam, ✠ absolutiónem et remissiónem peccatórum nostrórum tríbuat nobis omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus. Amen.
content.english: May the almighty ✠ and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.
content.english: ℣. Turn us then, ✙︎ O God, our saviour:

segments.t: Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.

content.latin: ℟. Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
content.english: ℟. And let thy anger cease from us.

segments.t: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Miserére * mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: Ant. Have mercy * on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

segments.t: Ant.
Miserére * mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: Psalmus 4 [1]
content.english: Psalm 4 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 4

content.latin: 4:2 Cum invocárem exaudívit me Deus iustítiæ meæ: * in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.
content.english: 4:2 When I called upon him, the God of my justice heard me: * when I was in distress, thou hast enlarged me.

segments.t: Cum invocárem exaudívit me Deus iustítiæ meæ: * in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.

content.latin: 4:2 Miserére mei, * et exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: 4:2 Have mercy on me: * and hear my prayer.

segments.t: Miserére mei, * et exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: 4:3 Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
content.english: 4:3 O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? * Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying?

segments.t: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?

content.latin: 4:4 Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
content.english: 4:4 Know ye also that the Lord hath made his holy one wonderful: * the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto him.

segments.t: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.

content.latin: 4:5 Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
content.english: 4:5 Be ye angry, and sin not: * the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.

segments.t: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.

content.latin: 4:6 Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
content.english: 4:6 Offer up the sacrifice of justice, and trust in the Lord: * many say, Who sheweth us good things?

segments.t: Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?

content.latin: 4:7 Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
content.english: 4:7 The light of thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: * thou hast given gladness in my heart.

segments.t: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.

content.latin: 4:8 A fructu fruménti, vini, et ólei sui * multiplicáti sunt.
content.english: 4:8 By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, * they are multiplied.

segments.t: A fructu fruménti, vini, et ólei sui * multiplicáti sunt.

content.latin: 4:9 In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;
content.english: 4:9 In peace in the selfsame * I will sleep, and I will rest:

segments.t: In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;

content.latin: 4:10 Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.
content.english: 4:10 For thou, O Lord, singularly * hast settled me in hope.

segments.t: Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 90 [2]
content.english: Psalm 90 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 90

content.latin: 90:1 Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
content.english: 90:1 He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, * shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.

content.latin: 90:2 Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.
content.english: 90:2 He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: * my God, in him will I trust.

segments.t: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.

content.latin: 90:3 Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.
content.english: 90:3 For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: * and from the sharp word.

segments.t: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.

content.latin: 90:4 Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.
content.english: 90:4 He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: * and under his wings thou shalt trust.

segments.t: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.

content.latin: 90:5 Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
content.english: 90:5 His truth shall compass thee with a shield: * thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

segments.t: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,

content.latin: 90:6 A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.
content.english: 90:6 Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark: * of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

segments.t: A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.

content.latin: 90:7 Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.
content.english: 90:7 A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand: * but it shall not come nigh thee.

segments.t: Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.

content.latin: 90:8 Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
content.english: 90:8 But thou shalt consider with thy eyes: * and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

segments.t: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.

content.latin: 90:9 Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
content.english: 90:9 Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.

segments.t: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.

content.latin: 90:10 Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
content.english: 90:10 There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

segments.t: Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.

content.latin: 90:11 Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
content.english: 90:11 For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.t: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.

content.latin: 90:12 In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
content.english: 90:12 In their hands they shall bear thee up: * lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

segments.t: In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.

content.latin: 90:13 Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
content.english: 90:13 Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

segments.t: Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.

content.latin: 90:14 Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
content.english: 90:14 Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.

segments.t: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.

content.latin: 90:15 Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
content.english: 90:15 He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: * I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.

segments.t: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.

content.latin: 90:16 Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
content.english: 90:16 I will fill him with length of days; * and I will shew him my salvation.

segments.t: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 133 [3]
content.english: Psalm 133 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 133

content.latin: 133:1 Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, * omnes servi Dómini:
content.english: 133:1 Behold now bless ye the Lord, * all ye servants of the Lord:

segments.t: Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, * omnes servi Dómini:

content.latin: 133:1 Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
content.english: 133:1 Who stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

segments.t: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.

content.latin: 133:2 In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, * et benedícite Dóminum.
content.english: 133:2 In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, * and bless ye the Lord.

segments.t: In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, * et benedícite Dóminum.

content.latin: 133:3 Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: 133:3 May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, * he that made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, * qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Miserére mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: Ant. Have mercy on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

segments.t: Ant.
Miserére mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: Te lucis ante términum,
content.english: Before the ending of the day,

content.latin: Rerum Creátor, póscimus,
content.english: Creator of the world, we pray

content.latin: Ut pro tua cleméntia
content.english: That with thy wonted favor thou

content.latin: Sis præsul et custódia.
content.english: Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

content.latin: Procul recédant sómnia,
content.english: From all ill dreams defend our eyes,

content.latin: Et nóctium phantásmata;
content.english: From nightly fears and fantasies;

content.latin: Hostémque nostrum cómprime,
content.english: Tread under foot our ghostly foe,

content.latin: Ne polluántur córpora.
content.english: That no pollution we may know.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: O Father, that we ask be done,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ier 14:9
content.english: Jer 14:9

segments.t: Ier 14:9

content.latin: Tu autem in nobis es, Dómine, et nomen sanctum tuum invocátum est super nos: ne derelínquas nos, Dómine, Deus noster.
content.english: But thou, O Lord, art among us, and thy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟.br. In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.
content.english: ℟.br. Into thy hands, O Lord, * do I commend my spirit.

segments.t: ℟.br.
In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.

content.latin: ℟. In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.
content.english: ℟. Into thy hands, O Lord, * do I commend my spirit.

segments.t: In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.

content.latin: ℣. Redemísti nos, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
content.english: ℣. For thou hast redeemed us, O Lord, God of truth.

segments.t: Redemísti nos, Dómine, Deus veritátis.

content.latin: ℟. Comméndo spíritum meum.
content.english: ℟. I commend my spirit.

segments.t: Comméndo spíritum meum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.
content.english: ℟. Into thy hands, O Lord, * do I commend my spirit.

segments.t: In manus tuas, Dómine, * Comméndo spíritum meum.

content.latin: ℣. Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.
content.english: ℣. Keep us, Lord, as the apple of thine eye.

segments.t: Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.

content.latin: ℟. Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.
content.english: ℟. Protect us under the shadow of thy wings.

segments.t: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.

content.latin: Ant. Salva nos, * Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.
content.english: Ant. Protect us, * Lord, while we are awake and safeguard us while we sleep; that we may keep watch with Christ, and rest in peace.

segments.t: Ant.
Salva nos, * Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.

content.latin: Canticum Simeonis
content.english: Canticle of Simeon

segments.t: Canticum Simeonis

content.latin: 2:29 Nunc dimíttis ✠ servum tuum, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum in pace:
content.english: 2:29 Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, ✠ * according to thy word in peace;

segments.t: Nunc dimíttis ✠ servum tuum, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum in pace:

content.latin: 2:30 Quia vidérunt óculi mei * salutáre tuum,
content.english: 2:30 Because my eyes have seen * thy salvation,

segments.t: Quia vidérunt óculi mei * salutáre tuum,

content.latin: 2:31 Quod parásti * ante fáciem ómnium populórum,
content.english: 2:31 Which thou hast prepared * before the face of all peoples:

segments.t: Quod parásti * ante fáciem ómnium populórum,

content.latin: 2:32 Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
content.english: 2:32 A light to the revelation of the Gentiles, * and the glory of thy people Israel.

segments.t: Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Salva nos, Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.
content.english: Ant. Protect us, Lord, while we are awake and safeguard us while we sleep; that we may keep watch with Christ, and rest in peace.

segments.t: Ant.
Salva nos, Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
content.english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Benedictio. Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.
content.english: Benediction. The almighty and merciful Lord, ✠ the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, bless us and keep us.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Alma Redemptóris Mater, quæ pérvia cæli porta manes,
content.english: Mother of Christ, hear thou thy people's cry

content.latin: et stella maris, succúrre cadénti,
content.english: Star of the deep and Portal of the sky!

content.latin: Súrgere qui curat, pópulo: tu quæ genuísti,
content.english: Mother of Him who thee from nothing made.

content.latin: Natúra miránte, tuum sanctum Genitórem,
content.english: Sinking we strive and call to thee for aid:

content.latin: Virgo prius ac postérius, Gabriélis ab ore
content.english: O, by what joy which Gabriel brought to thee,

content.latin: Sumens illud Ave, peccatórum miserére.
content.english: Thou Virgin first and last, let us thy mercy see.

content.latin: ℣. Ángelus Dómini nuntiávit Maríæ.
content.english: ℣. The Angel of the Lord announced unto Mary.

segments.t: Ángelus Dómini nuntiávit Maríæ.

content.latin: ℟. Et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.
content.english: ℟. And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.

segments.t: Et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Grátiam tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde: ut, qui, Ángelo nuntiánte, Christi Fílii tui incarnatiónem cognóvimus; per passiónem eius et crucem, ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur. Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
content.english: Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy grace into our hearts: that as we have known the incarnation of thy Son Jesus Christ by the message of an Angel, so too by his Cross and passion may we be brought to the glory of his resurrection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

segments.t: Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.
